summary: Willamette National Forest L-4 cab on Jump-Off Joe, built 1935-36, staffed in the late 1930s and 1943, and removed in 1965. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cab removed in 1965; no source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give 1935 for the L-4 cab; Forest Lookouts quotes a 1935 plan and dates the L-4 house to 1936
Wayne Wood on duty for the summer, per a Lebanon Express item quoted by Forest Lookouts
William C. Cook named emergency lookout fireman, per an Albany Democrat-Herald item quoted by Forest Lookouts
Staffed by volunteers from Mountain States Power Company using their vacation time
Register and Forest Lookouts say removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Date registered per FFLOS detail page: May 8, 2011

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1935 for the L-4 cab. Forest Lookouts quotes an October 1935 plan for the station and dates the constructed L-4 lookout house to 1936. Both are kept; the story gives both.
The register and Forest Lookouts say the cab was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1965. Both are kept; the story reports the wording of the sources.

notes_for_editor: The built year (1935 vs 1936) and the fate wording (removed vs destroyed) conflict across the three sources; both are reported. Staffing is documented only for 1937, 1939 and 1943 in the newspaper items quoted by Forest Lookouts; no later staffing was found. No source describes the site today or gives visitor access, so the brief's access 'unknown' is unchanged and no access fact is recorded. The web search for 'Jump Off Joe' returned mostly a Washington lookout of the same name (jumpoff-joe, Naches Ranger District); it was not used. The Kemnow 2020 PDF on orww.org repeats the Forest Lookouts text and adds no later site history. The Oregon heritage eligibility PDF (heritagedata.prd.state.or.us, load=44761.pdf) has no text layer and could not be read; it may describe the historic lookouts on the Willamette National Forest.
